with verbatim_days, appraisal must return a short gist; exact words are shown only within the window, then the gist while the episode stays accessible; originals are stored unchanged; without the setting nothing changes
semantic_matching cues a faded memory by meaning ("shouted" finds "yelled") with no shared words; an unreachable embedding service falls back to word matching, flagged on every result
recall_beta samples memories in proportion to exp(beta * score): high beta matches greedy ranking, low beta wanders, the draw is deterministic per query and inspection stays read-only
rumination_neuroticism raises background recall rate with neuroticism and leans it toward negative memories; k=0 is unchanged
mood_encoding_weight strengthens memories encoded in a strong mood; explicit stability and the default are unchanged
affect_from_traits derives reactivity, inertia and rumination from current neuroticism/extraversion; an average person is unchanged and explicit affect_parameters win
the average mood kernel keeps a steady stream of mild events mild (the power-law sum saturates arousal), lets a strong event dominate, and stays within bounds
